why: No major reviewer or authority compares the AeroClip 2 with the C50i. The results are Soundcore's own product and category pages, two B&H spec tables and a HearWiki score page that all compare the original AeroClip, not the AeroClip 2, plus four empty PDFs and an unreadable forum thread. A focused page comparing the two on specs, tested call/sound differences and current prices with the C50i code would be the only direct answer.
